page-section.$description: PageSection's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--page-section-<name>) on the page, a container or one PageSection, and every one inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

border.$description: The line on top with divider.

padding-y-sm.$description: Space above and below with spacing="sm" (32px).

padding-y-md.$description: Space above and below with spacing="md", below 768px (48px).

padding-y-md-wide.$description: Space above and below with spacing="md", from 768px (64px).

padding-y-lg.$description: Space above and below with spacing="lg", below 768px (64px).

padding-y-lg-wide.$description: Space above and below with spacing="lg", from 768px (96px).

gap.$description: The space between the children when gap isn't given (32px).
